text.zh: 预设模式：汽车、自行车、摩托车、球类

text.en: Max 150 PSI, 12V DC or 220V AC Use

description.en:
Our digital tire inflators combine precision pressure monitoring with rapid inflation for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. The 30mm cylinder delivers fast inflation, while the digital display shows accurate pressure in PSI, BAR, or KPA.

Features include preset pressure with auto-stop, 12000mAh battery with USB power bank function, LED emergency light, and 150PSI max pressure. The compact design fits easily in your glove box or trunk.

We provide OEM/ODM services: custom colors, branding, and packaging. MOQ 300 units, production lead time 25-35 days.
description.zh:
我们的数字充气泵将精确的压力监测与快速充气相结合，适用于汽车、摩托车和自行车。30mm气缸实现快速充气，数字显示屏以PSI、BAR或KPA显示精确压力。

功能包括预设压力自动停止、12000mAh电池带充电宝功能、LED应急灯，以及150PSI最大压力。紧凑设计轻松放入手套箱或后备箱。

我们提供OEM/ODM服务：定制颜色、品牌和包装。最小起订量300台，大货交期25-35天。
